intro: Laird's Response is a sealed dispatch penned by the fish curer Laird in the coastal port of Auberdine. Written for Nessa Shadowsong in Rut'theran Village, the letter details curious ecological differences between mainland marine life and the unusually large fish thriving along Teldrassil's shores.

sections.t: A Matter of Scales and Roots
p: After reviewing catch reports from across the Veiled Sea, Laird of Auberdine noted a striking discrepancy: the fish hauled from Teldrassil's coast are remarkably larger and more plentiful than those taken along the mainland beaches of Darkshore. In this written response addressed to Nessa Shadowsong, Laird shares his working theory—that the unnatural presence and raw vitality of the newly planted World Tree may be warping and stimulating the surrounding marine life. Delivered by travelers returning across the waters, the letter prompts wonder and quiet curiosity among the fisherfolk of Rut'theran Village.
